main_body: Sci-fi tower building: an upper hip-roof cap with a windowed band, a narrow central tower, and a lower sloped skirt roof above a door base
top_band: Light blue-grey roof slope, rows 8-16 at x=35 (L118 to L148 to L178 front-edge highlight), then a dark eave row at 18
evidence: The upper roof is a foreshortened trapezoid slope about 9 rows tall. It ends in a lighter 2-row front-edge line (rows 15-16, L178) and a dark eave row at 18, above the windowed front face (rows 19-29). The windows sit inset in a dark frame. The lower skirt roof (rows 52-62) also reads as a sloped top above the door front. The central tower shaft is a flat front face, but it is a connecting element and not the main volume. Overall it satisfies the 3/4 contract for a building.

style.evidence: The roof ramp has about 5 steps (118, 148, 178, 93, 34). The outline is a bluish dark (#1c2230) with 0% neutral edge pixels, so it is tinted and reads as dark_material_tone. Against that, 21% of pixels sit in flat 5x5 fills (the references have 0%). These are the tower shaft, the lower skirt panels and the dark base interior. The candidate has only 31 distinct colours, against 66 and 185 for the references. Its median of 9 colours per tile is below both references (11 and 18). It has no tile scallops, grain or speckle like the references, so it looks flatter and more sticker-like beside them.
